resources.string: FIDO2 / WebAuthn over FIDO Bluetooth LE

If pairing fails, forget Chimali on the phone and PC wherever it appears, then pair again. Confirm that the numbers match on both screens. Return here and retry. This does not remove saved passkeys, and restarting the app is not required.
FIDO Bluetooth LE accepts connections initiated by the PC or other host. To start a request, choose Chimali from the host’s security key list.
